name: Proposal Engagement
summary: Scores Deep Funding Portal users based on proposal outcomes and community ratings.
description:
### What it does
Scores proposal owners based on proposal outcomes and community ratings.

### How it works
- Each user is identified by their DID.
- Funded and completed proposals add points.
- Unfunded proposals remove points.
- Higher ratings increase rewards and reduce penalties.
- Older proposals can lose value over time.

### Limits
Only rounds 31, 36, and 107 are included because they have reliable ownership data.

### Data source
Uses proposal, user, and review data from the Deep Funding Portal.

### Outputs
- CSV file with `did` and `proposal_engagement`.
- JSON file with score details for each user and proposal.

inputs.label: Funded proposal reward
inputs.description: How much a funded and completed proposal increases the score. Use `0` to turn off this reward.

inputs.label: Unfunded proposal penalty
inputs.description: How much an unfunded proposal reduces the score. Use `0` to turn off this penalty.

inputs.label: Lookback period (months)
inputs.description: Only proposals from this number of past months are included. A short period may exclude all supported rounds and give every user a score of `0`.

inputs.label: Monthly decay (%)
inputs.description: Percentage removed from a proposal's score for each month of age. Use `0` to turn off decay.

outputs.label: Proposal engagement (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per user with their final proposal engagement score.

columns.description: Raw user score. It is not normalized and can be negative when penalties are higher than rewards.

outputs.label: Proposal engagement details (JSON)
outputs.description: Score details and skip reasons for each user and proposal.
